title: Logistics Manager
description:
Reporting To: Factory Head / Supply Chain Head Job Purpose To manage the end-to-end logistics and transportation operations of the company, ensuring timely, safe and cost-effective movement of finished goods from the factory/warehouse to customers, distributors and other locations. Key Responsibilities Plan and manage daily dispatch and transportation operations as per sales and customer requirements. Coordinate with Sales, Warehouse, Production and Accounts to ensure smooth and timely dispatch. Plan vehicle requirements, loading schedules, routes and delivery priorities. Develop and manage a reliable network of transporters and logistics service providers . Negotiate freight rates and control transportation costs. Monitor vehicle placement, loading, dispatch and delivery status. Track shipments and ensure on-time delivery to customers/distributors. Monitor vehicle utilization, route efficiency, freight cost and delivery performance. Ensure proper documentation including invoices, e-way bills, LR/GR, delivery challans and other dispatch documents. Coordinate with Warehouse to ensure correct product, quantity, batch, expiry and FEFO-based dispatch . Handle transportation-related issues such as vehicle delays, breakdowns, shortages, damages and delivery disputes. Maintain transporter performance records and conduct regular performance reviews. Verify freight bills against approved rates, routes and actual deliveries before submitting them for payment. Identify opportunities for route optimization, load consolidation and freight cost reduction . Monitor customer delivery complaints and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure proper handling and transportation of food/FMCG products to maintain product quality and hygiene. Maintain daily, weekly and monthly logistics MIS and KPI reports for management. Ensure compliance with company logistics policies, safety requirements and applicable statutory requirements. Key KPIs On-Time Delivery (OTD) % Freight cost per unit / case / kg Vehicle placement efficiency Vehicle utilization Delivery turnaround time Transporter performance Delivery shortage/damage % Customer delivery complaints Freight bill accuracy Route optimization / cost savings Dispatch accuracy Pending/undelivered shipments Qualification & Experience Graduate in Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, Business Management or related field; MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain/Logistics preferred. 5-10 years of experience in logistics, transportation or supply chain, preferably in FMCG/Food Manufacturing. Strong knowledge of FMCG distribution, secondary transportation and dispatch operations . Good negotiation and transporter/vendor management skills. Strong knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/logistics systems. Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage time-sensitive dispatches. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have strong experience in FMCG logistics and transportation , good knowledge of local and interstate routes, transporter networks, freight negotiation and delivery management. The candidate should be capable of controlling logistics costs while ensuring 100% accurate and timely dispatch and delivery .

Key Skills: Logistics,vendor management,Warehouse,FMCG distribution,dispatch,Vehicle utilization,freight negotiation,transportation operations
